title: POST:/^\/tools\/(\d+)\/damage$/
description: Its route in `createRouter`, which reads the JSON body, calls the handler and turns a `LendingError` into its status with `{ error, message }`. The body limit is `readBody` with `MAX_BODY_BYTES` (64 KB) and `sendAndClose`, shared by every route: a declared length over the limit is refused before any byte is read, a chunked or endless body is read only up to the limit, and the 413 is written whole with `Connection: close` before the connection closes.
